say:1:1033345001:1.text: We are thinking about distributing a portion of our goods, particularly the medicinal herbs, to villagers for emergency use.
say:1:1033345001:1.source_cn: 哦，我们在考虑，可以先把部分货物分给村里的村民，让他们...
say:1:1033345001:1.male: We are thinking about distributing a portion of our goods, particularly the medicinal herbs, to villagers for emergency use.
say:1:1033345001:1.female: We are thinking about distributing a portion of our goods, particularly the medicinal herbs, to villagers for emergency use.

say:2:1033345002:1.text: It's better than piling up there and slowly losing their effectiveness.
say:2:1033345002:1.source_cn: 如此一来，起码不会因为搁置太久而使草药失去疗效。
say:2:1033345002:1.male: It's better than piling up there and slowly losing their effectiveness.
say:2:1033345002:1.female: It's better than piling up there and slowly losing their effectiveness.

say:3:1033345003:1.text: These fresh herbs are totally different from the dried ones; they are the pride of the Dark Forest!
say:3:1033345003:1.source_cn: 新鲜草药和晒干的效果可不一样！草药是薄暮丛林的骄傲！
say:3:1033345003:1.male: These fresh herbs are totally different from the dried ones; they are the pride of the Dark Forest!
say:3:1033345003:1.female: These fresh herbs are totally different from the dried ones; they are the pride of the Dark Forest!

say:4:1033345004:1.text: I'm not ready to give up on them yet.
say:4:1033345004:1.source_cn: 我可不想这么简单就放弃。
say:4:1033345004:1.male: I'm not ready to give up on them yet.
say:4:1033345004:1.female: I'm not ready to give up on them yet.
